title: Vega-Lite: one selection, linked analytical views
summary: Make a brush and setting filter drive the same points, linked sums, record table and explicit selected-versus-all population.
use_when: A bounded analytical exploration needs coordinated views with fixed scales, truthful sums and a visible empty/reset path.
avoid_when: The brief needs a production data engine, unknown denominator, causal inference or a merely ornamental dashboard.
